primary_research_tasks: Recover a reliable Greek text/translation and commentary for Marcian's Periplus and its Menippus epitome.
Recover a critical edition/translation of Martianus Capella's De nuptiis, especially books VI–IX.
Build passage-level operator ledger, citations and adversarial controls.
Compare with Strabo, Ptolemy, Pliny, Vitruvius and ancient mathematical geography only after primary witness checks.
